headline: Best Buy (BBY) Appoints Anne Bramman As CFO For Its Next Growth Push
summary: Best Buy (NYSE:BBY) has appointed Anne Bramman as Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President. Bramman is scheduled to assume the role on August 19, 2026. She brings experience from senior finance and analytics roles at Nordstrom, Circana, Avery Dennison, and Carnival Cruise Line. Best Buy enters this leadership change with its stock at $85.25 and a mixed performance profile. The share price is up 23.2% year to date and 34.4% over the past year, while the 5 year return is down...
